newsitem.title: USA: Ecogen gets EPA okay to market NoMate.
newsitem.headline: Ecogen gets EPA okay to market NoMate.

text.p: Ecogen Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency has given it approval to market its insecticide products NoMate LRX and NoMate BHF.
The company said NoMate LRX is used to control obliquibanded leafrollers in fruit trees, principally apples. NoMate BHF controls blackheaded fireworms in cranberries.
The company will target its marketing in Washington, Oregon, Wisconsin and Michigan. It estimates the market at about $13 million. Limited market introduction will begin this year.
The two products make use of a naturally occurring pheromone produced by the females of the target insect species, it said. The products work by disrupting the insects' reproduction.
